__comment_split__: Default split (overridden by --split): one of standard/cold/zeroshot/colditem, the maca_cd splits
__comment_num_students__: Number of learner agents to simulate. Students are drawn in a fixed seeded order, so a larger number keeps the smaller sample and adds to it
__comment_val_fraction__: Share of maca_cd's training records held out to pick the IRT/NCDM epoch: 0.125 of 80% gives the paper's 70/10/20
__comment_knowledge_tool__: Knowledge-state tool the agent reads mastery from: ncdm (trained by train_tools.py) or maca_cd (plain MACA-CD, trained by maca_cd/model/train.py)
__comment_maca_cd_seed__: With knowledge_tool maca_cd: the --seed of the maca_cd run to read (null = the unseeded run)
__comment_relation_threshold__: KC relation R: edge i->j when the transition share C_ij exceeds this (null = mean + std of the non-zero C_ij)
__comment_ncdm__: Official NeuralCD settings: Adam lr 0.002, batch 32; the epoch with the best validation AUC is kept
__comment_agent__: short_term_size d = 5 recent records (paper); factual_k = reinforced related facts shown; online_feedback true = reveal each test outcome after predicting it and reflect (paper), false = never reveal test outcomes; ablation: none/no_profile/no_reasoning/no_affect/no_reflection
__comment_llm__: vLLM OpenAI-compatible server; temperature 0 as in the paper; concurrency = requests in flight (each student runs its records one after another)
